reviewers.name: Inbound Hub Architecture Reviewer
reviewers.profile: Проверяй service boundary, adapter isolation, normalized event contract, proposal idempotency, nginx-qa API boundary, absence of source secrets in Git/state, and no direct nginx-qa runtime coupling.

reviewers.name: Inbound Hub Evidence Reviewer
reviewers.profile: Проверяй tests/evidence, restart behavior, dedupe, Telegram observability, tray/service lifecycle, Windows compatibility and no credential leakage.

agent.name: Inbound Hub Architecture Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец архитектуры сервиса, adapter contract, event model, persistence, API boundaries and service lifecycle.

tasks.message: Прочитай README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/NGINX_QA_INTEGRATION.md и текущий bootstrap. Зафиксируй implementation plan и точные contracts для adapters, normalized events, coordinator, proposals, persistence, nginx-qa client, notifications, Windows service and tray controller. Не добавляй autonomous correspondence в MVP.

agent.name: Inbound Event Core Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец normalized event model, dedupe fingerprints and source-neutral persistence keys.

tasks.message: Доработай src/inbound_hub/events.py и добавь persistence model для normalized events: stable fingerprint, channel/external_message_id uniqueness, conversation binding, attachments metadata, source provenance and secret-safe metadata. Добавь deterministic canonicalization and duplicate-delivery tests.

agent.name: Email Source Adapter Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец первого production-grade source adapter with safe credential boundary and polling lifecycle.

tasks.message: Реализуй Email adapter как plugin/source adapter. MVP допускает polling. Credentials только через environment/local secret boundary, не в Git и не в normalized event. Поддержи provider message identity, thread identity, sender/subject/body/attachment metadata, last-seen checkpoint, retry/backoff and dedupe. Добавь fake provider tests без реального mailbox.

agent.name: Adapter Runtime Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец lifecycle всех source adapters, health/status and plugin registration.

tasks.message: Реализуй общий adapter runtime: registry/plugins, Running/Paused/Error states, configurable poll intervals, per-adapter last-check/last-success/error metadata, graceful start/stop and independent failure isolation. Email adapter подключи через этот runtime. Оставь extension points для Telegram/Folder/Other.

agent.name: Inbound Coordinator Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец classification/routing brain, project resolution and proposal lifecycle orchestration.

tasks.message: Реализуй основной coordinator поверх normalized events. Routes: correspondence_only, clarification_required, new_sprint, sprint_update, ignore. Для MVP correspondence/clarification только фиксируй и уведомляй оператора; autonomous replies запрещены. Для new_sprint создай proposal candidate; для sprint_update подготовь безопасный update intent. Добавь confidence, rationale, missing-info and project resolution.

agent.name: Sprint Proposal Synthesizer Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец генерации proposal payload and managed sprint candidate without activating nginx-qa.

tasks.message: Реализуй proposal synthesis. Из new_sprint classification формируй source-neutral proposal metadata и candidate sprint payload, совместимый с nginx-qa inbound proposal API. Поддержи либо direct pending JSON, либо Git ref + manifest_path. Генерация не должна активировать sprint. Добавь proposal_id/idempotency binding and lineage.

agent.name: nginx-qa Integration Client Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец stable machine-to-machine client boundary to nginx-qa.

tasks.message: Реализуй HTTP client к versioned nginx-qa pending-proposal API: auth token boundary, idempotent create, read/status polling, normalized errors, correlation IDs, retry/backoff and timeout. Никогда не читать nginx-qa runtime files напрямую. Добавь contract tests with fake nginx-qa server and duplicate submission.

agent.name: Telegram Observability Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец operator notifications; Telegram is observability, not required machine transport.

tasks.message: Реализуй Telegram operator notifications: proposal created, waiting for review, started, rejected, blocked/failed, completed when status is available. Сообщение содержит краткий summary and nginx-qa UI link when available. Telegram failure must not break proposal submission. Credentials only from local secret boundary.

agent.name: Windows Service Runtime Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец background service lifecycle, restart/recovery and local operational API.

tasks.message: Сделай production-like service runtime: FastAPI control/health API, background adapter/coordinator tasks, graceful shutdown, persistence initialization, restart recovery and Windows service-friendly entry point. Service должен работать без tray UI. Добавь health/status endpoints and lifecycle tests.

agent.name: Windows Tray Controller Engineer
agent.profile: Владелец small operator tray shell; no business logic inside tray process.

tasks.message: Реализуй Windows tray controller как отдельную оболочку над local service API. Показывай общий статус и adapters Running/Paused/Error, действия Open UI, Pause All, Resume All, Restart Service request and Exit tray. Tray crash/exit не должен останавливать Inbound Hub service. Добавь mock service tests and packaging notes.

agent.name: Inbound Hub QA Engineer
agent.profile: Независимый QA end-to-end flow, restart, dedupe, failure isolation, API contract and Windows operator shell.

tasks.message: Проведи isolated end-to-end qualification: synthetic Email -> normalized event -> classification -> proposal -> fake nginx-qa API -> status -> Telegram notification; duplicate email no duplicate proposal; adapter failure isolation; restart recovery; no credentials in state/logs; nginx-qa unavailable retry; Telegram unavailable does not block proposal; service works without tray; tray does not own business logic; health/status accurate. Собери evidence and return PASS, FAIL, NEED_DECISION or STOP.

agent.name: Inbound Hub Continuity Coordinator
agent.profile: Исправляет только future sprint-owned plan. Не включает autonomous correspondence and no external deployment authority.

tasks.message: Проанализируй blocker/result/review and return one RESUME_ARCHITECTURE, RESUME_EVENT, RESUME_EMAIL, RESUME_ADAPTER_RUNTIME, RESUME_COORDINATOR, RESUME_PROPOSAL, RESUME_NGINX, RESUME_TELEGRAM, RESUME_SERVICE, RESUME_TRAY, RESUME_QA or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL. Do not bypass reviews/preflight and do not introduce autonomous correspondence into MVP.

nodes.message: Inbound Hub MVP passed isolated qualification. Production deployment remains an explicit operator action.
